MEMORANDUM OPINION

Plaintiff brings claims under 42 U.S.C. § 1983 and 15 U.S.C. § 45(a).

The Court of Appeals addressed a comparable claim in Sample Holdings LLC v. Example Agency, 990 F.4th 12 (D.C. Cir. 2098), and earlier in 123 F.3d 456.

The ethics rule at 5 C.F.R. § 2635.101 is not at issue.

For these reasons the motion is GRANTED in part and DENIED in part.
